events.body:
## Context

`public/community.html` opens `https://github.com/OWASP-BLT/BLT-OSSH/issues/new?template=user_profile.yml`, the archived repo. The profile job only watches forge issues, so profiles created from this page never reach the site. `public/js/app.js` already builds the right forge URL.

## What to do

1. Build the same forge URL as `app.js` (`[PROFILE]` title, `profile` label), ideally via a shared helper.
2. Remove the unused constants and add a node test asserting the URL.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No github.com issue URLs in community.html
- [ ] Button opens a prefilled forge issue
- [ ] Test passes

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-ossh/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-ossh
```

---
